item.title: Some good skills for agent [updating]
item.description:
When I’m using claudecode helping me with my work, I found that skills are quite important and can make the vibe coding process much more effective.

I have compiled some useful skills below, some of which are original creations of mine.

PDF skill - original Get the skill here

PDF Skill can directly extract text from PDF files or use OCR to recognize text, then convert the PDF content into structured JSON format.

SSH skill - original Get the skill here

SSH skill helps your agent ssh to other computer quickly.
